description: Na₂CoP₂O₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.65 Å) and four longer (2.68 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Co is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. All Co-O bond lengths are 1.96 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.64 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom.
